notes.title: The ultimate update
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33889897/767b96b9075fa84fd4ae8609210994a8793cc113.png"][/img][/p][p]Graphic updates: there's a new game menu and we have an in-game menu as well. Some popular NPCs have faces now. [/p][p]Pep receives a letter in Part 3 from a person he met previously. You can follow the girl's fate a bit further.[/p][p]With each update we paid special attention to keep the game as outdated as it was in its original era. We do not plan to make any more updates, maybe just improve some wordings.[/p][p][b]Thank you for being a part of this![/b] 
So now we stomach and neck...[/p]

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes: Happy New Year! Some more minor characters have faces now. Tiny fixes in overall the trilogy and small changes were made in DLC content as well. So never mind, well, okay.

notes.title: English version in progress
notes.notes:
The international situation intensifies, so we've started to translate KóterGame to English. The first game's translated version may be released in a few weeks. Or a month. Or so. Prepare for sandstorm.
